Name: Dreamscape
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
To enter the Dreamscape, double-tap interact on Emily's parrot.

To leave the Dreamscape, double-tap interact on Emily's parrot.

Do not enter the Dreamscape on drugs. Don't do drugs, do the Dreamscape.

[b]
[/b]You can edit the config in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or by editing the mod's config.json file after starting the game once.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9633]Extra Map Layers[/url], uses Harmony.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].

Manifest.Description: Adds Emily's Dreamscape as a farmable, foragable game location with crystal weeds, gem spawns, real dream trees, and a rejuvenation fairy.
